basics.name: Jalen Lum
basics.label: B.S. Computer Science - UH Mānoa
basics.summary: I am pursuing a B.S. in Computer Science in the Department of Information and Computer Sciences at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa, with an expected graduation date of December 2025. I plan to apply for the M.S. in Computer Science to begin in Spring 2026.

education.institution: University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa, Honolulu, HI
activities: GNC Software Developer, Team Robotic Space Exploration (RoSE)

work.summary: Part-time Web Application Developer for the UH System (ITS)

work.company: State of Hawaiʻi Department of Transportation
work.summary: Developed automated geospatial systems and web applications for construction permit processing.
highlights: Engineered a webhook integration system that connected Survey123 form submissions to a custom Python REST API using Flask, triggering automated email notifications based on geospatial logic, and reducing manual conflict-checking time by 90%.

Developed a full-stack web application using ArcGIS, HTML, and Flask to consolidate and streamline the process of applying for, processing, and issuing construction permits, reducing total processing time by 90% and improving turnaround for over 180 submissions.

work.summary: Part-time Administrative Assistant for the College of Natural Sciences Dean's Office.
highlights: Revamped the Learning Emporium website using React.js, Django, and TypeScript, streamlining the tutor schedule update process from seven steps down to one.
Provided technical support by troubleshooting and repairing hardware and software issues on both Mac and Windows machines.

work.company: University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa, Department of Information and Computer Sciences
work.summary: Learning Assistant for ICS 241 (Discrete Mathematics II).
highlights: Supported over 60 students by providing guidance on algorithms and data structure concepts, resulting in improved comprehension and academic performance across the class.

volunteer.summary: President of 8bit, a student-led software engineering Special Interest Group at UH Mānoa.
highlights: Developed 4 full-stack web applications for distinct clients using React, TypeScript, Django, PostgreSQL, and Firebase, securing $2500+ in funding to support club operations.
Designed and implemented CI/CD pipelines with Docker, GitHub Actions, and AWS Lightsail, automating deployments and reducing manual release overhead by 90%.
Led a 10-person software engineering team using Agile sprints and GitHub Projects to deliver client software on time and improve development cycle efficiency.
Refactored the user interface, consolidating six intermediary pages into a single streamlined interface, increasing efficiency and user experience.
Implemented a speedometer and systems page component, enhancing real-time data visualization for rover metrics using React.js and JavaScript.
